The '''Toong''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toong'l/Legends|Toong'l]]. In comparison with many other humanoids, their heads were disproportionately large for their bodies. 

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Toong_AA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]]]]

Toong spoke the language [[Toongese]].<ref name="UAA" /><ref name="AA" /> The Toong had long gangly legs, no neck, and bulbous bodies. Their eyes were high on their pointed forehead, and their cheeks were jowled. Toong could store food in their cheeks, much like the rodents they were assumed to have evolved from.

Toong exhibited severe nervousness. Weak-willed and frightened of confrontation, Toong almost always gave in to an aggressor when threatened. Toong only truly felt safe when around immediate family. They, however, were not cowards; they simply dreaded interaction with other [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] creatures.

==History==
[[File:Toong_UAA.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A Toong]]
The species was barely beginning their first steps toward exploring their home system when they were discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The appearance of other sentient life, with technology far more advanced than their own, threw the Toong homeworld into utter chaos. As a result, a world war triggered. This came as a shock to the [[first contact specialist]] who had observed the species and documented them as being peace-loving and outgoing. It took weeks to re-establish contact with the Toong. It took the intervention of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the first contact specialist from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to stop the massive warfare that was threatening to doom the species.

After joining the Old Republic, the Toong began rapidly advancing their technology. Reluctantly leaving their own system, the Toong scattered colonies throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. 
Their home planet, Toong'l, was devastated by a collision with a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] [[Comet/Legends|comet]] shortly before [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], and the surviving Toong were forced to relocate to the neighboring planet of [[Tund/Legends|Tund]]. 

Perhaps the most famous of these was [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]]. As a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] pilot, he competed primarily in the [[Pouffra Circuit]] but he also had one disappointing attempt at the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].
